items.title: Northrop Grumman (NOC) Just Sparked A Bigger Question
items.summary: Northrop Grumman (NOC) just landed a cluster of fresh contracts and program wins, from a US$1.6b PAC-3 missile order to a multi decade NASA weather satellite deal, sharpening investor attention. Despite the fresh contract wins, Northrop Grumman’s share price return is down 6% year to date, while the 1 year total shareholder return has slipped 2%. However, the 3 and 5 year total shareholder returns of 23% and 71% hint at longer term momentum that recent defense and space awards may help...
